FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDef.en: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt.en: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt.fr: Excusez-moi ! J'essaie de peindre.\nReste hors de ma vue, s'il te\lplaît !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos.en: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos.fr: GILLIAN ? Incline légèrement la\ntête… Voilà ! C'est le regard que\lje veux !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr.en: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr.fr: Avec ces mains, je créerai ma\nvictoire !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost.en: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost.fr: Oh non, mes tubes de peinture sont\néparpillés partout !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt.en: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt.fr: Je suis un bon coureur.\nJe suis très rapide !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos.en: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos.fr: Quand je cours avec le vent, j'ai\nl'impression de pouvoir voler !

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn.en: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn.fr: Je pense à faire construire une\npiscine spécialement pour POKéMON.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo.en: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo.fr: Une piscine serait agréable, mais\nune véranda serait sublime.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr.en: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr.fr: Je rends visite à la retraite de\nmon amie, si tu veux savoir.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost.en: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost.fr: J'aime combattre tranquillement\ndans la douce brise marine.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr.en: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr.fr: Hmm…\nL'angle n'est pas tout à fait ça…

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost.en: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost.fr: Le ciel et la mer…\nIls sont si changeants.\pLeurs expressions changeantes les\nrendent difficiles à saisir.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyTha.en: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefea.en: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro.en: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro.fr: Dis donc, la vie marine de ce\nresort me convient.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB.en: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.
FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB.fr: Prendre ça tellement au sérieux…\nQuel non-sens.
